summary: Iter 232N.29 League Home layout sync verified. All 6 target pytest cases pass + 5 additional edge cases (32-cap, oversize reject, non-string drop, >64 char id drop, visibility cap). Frontend customize toggle, hint text, dashed cyan outlines (rgba(0,210,255,0.5) dashed 2px), and 36px cyan pulsing drag handles all render exactly as spec'd. Server-persisted order hydrates on reload (verified by direct PATCH + reload showing Recent Transactions rendered on top instead of default Matchups-first order).
critical_code_review_comments: reconcileOrder drops IDs not in DEFAULT_ORDER — good defensive behaviour when a widget is retired.
Server PATCH only writes widget_order/visibility keys that are explicitly provided (dotted-path $set), so a partial patch correctly preserves the other field.
chriszarek user only owns one league (69e46af1...) in this env, so the cross-league scoping UI walk was verified via unit tests only. Backend test_patch_scoped_per_league covers this comprehensively.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing chriszarek league). Cleaned up post-test by resetting widget_order to [] via PATCH.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright mouse-drag does NOT trigger dnd-kit's PointerSensor reliably in this env, so drag-persistence was verified by directly calling PATCH endpoint via fetch() and observing the visual re-render after reload. The screenshot in run 2 confirmed 'Recent Transactions' rendered above 'Top Trade Block' after PATCH — proving server hydration works. Cross-league scoping was verified at API level (test_patch_scoped_per_league) since the test user only owns one league.
